correctness.rationale: The object is the open-neighborhood complex of the 15 pair-vertices of L(K6). A fresh independent Python implementation reconstructed all 2,881 faces, exact f-vector (1,15,105,420,945,840,420,120,15) including the empty face, 1,395 simplex-toggle pairs with one augmented empty pairing, and 91 remaining four-vertex faces. It independently checked acyclicity by topologically sorting all 2,881 nodes and all 12,945 signed Hasse cover arrows; after restoring one critical 0-cell the Morse CW model is point plus 91 3-cells, hence an integral wedge of 91 S^3 (not deduced from mod-2 Betti). Signed reduced Lefschetz traces independently computed across all 720 underlying S6 permutations reproduce all 11 conjugacy-class values (91,-13,7,7,1,-1,1,-3,-3,1,1) and the trivial multiplicity 0; the actual source verifier includes exact Murnaghan–Nakayama inner products giving the claimed Specht decomposition. Orbit quotient rational reduced homology vanishes by finite-group transfer, not contractibility.
residual_risks: Integral wedge follows from an acyclic nonequivariant matching, not an equivariant wedge decomposition; representation is only over Q.
